intro.text: A smuggler from Elendel's criminal world.
A well-known Elendel criminal, long suspected of smuggling ore into the city.

items.text: Dowser was among the first guests to approach Winsting Innate at the auction of his Senate vote, bringing a tall, slender woman with short golden hair. Winsting took her for a spy, perhaps from the constables, and had her watched. About an hour on, gunfire broke out from several parts of the room, and everyone upstairs died.

His reputation had earned him the invitation, since the auction was really a way of passing bribes to Winsting. Dowser perked up when Winsting hinted that his brother, the governor, could be bought as well. His companion asked Winsting some pointed questions.

One of Winsting's guards thought Dowser had fired first; another blamed Darm. Wax worked out that Bleeder, a kandra, had used Feruchemical steel to shoot from several spots in quick succession, setting the guests against one another.

appearance.text: Keeps his bowler hat on and skips shaving even on formal occasions.

personality.text: Blunt, crude and devious, and wary of situations he doesn't know.
